POPULATION EFFECTS: Subgroup analysis at 25th and 30th percentiles showed numerical differences (Rebif 332 vs 290 days at 25th percentile, 495 vs 432 days at 30th percentile) but no statistical significance reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was an adequately powered head-to-head comparison (N=764) with appropriate duration (96 weeks). No safety issues that would limit dosing. This appears to be a clean efficacy comparison that showed equivalence rather than superiority of either treatment.
